DEFINE INSTRUMENT neat_tof(
  lambda = 6,
  dlambda = 0.05,
  rpm = 10000,
  coh = "Rb_liq_coh.sqw",
  inc = "Rb_liq_inc.sqw",
  tmin = 0.01806,
  tmax = 0.01826
)

DECLARE
%{
  double Chopper2Detector = 11.97+2.143+0.165;
  double KI, Vi, EI;
  double Emin, Emax, Vmin, Vmax, Tmin, Tmax;
  double time_elastic;
  char detector_options[1024];
  char lmon_options[256];
  char tmon_options[256];
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  KI= 2*M_PI/lambda;
  Vi = 3956*fabs(KI);
  EI = 81.81*Vi*Vi/1e6;
  printf("%s: Detailed NEAT/TOF configuration\n", NAME_INSTRUMENT);
  printf("* Incoming beam: lambda=%.4g [Angs] EI=%.4g [meV]  KI=%.4g [Angs-1] Vi=%g [m/s]\n",
    lambda, EI, KI, Vi);
  time_elastic = 252.78*Chopper2Detector*lambda*1e-6; /* time from Chopper1 to reach Detector */
  printf("  Sample: coh=%s inc=%s\n", coh, inc);
  printf("          Elastic line time: %g [us]\n", time_elastic*1e6);
  Emin = EI-20; if (Emin < EI/3) Emin=EI/3;
  Emax = EI+20;
  Vmin = sqrt(Emin/81.81);
  Vmax = sqrt(Emax/81.81)*1e3;
  Tmin = 2.5/Vmax;
  Tmax = 2.5/Vmin;
  sprintf(detector_options,
    "banana, abs angle limits=[13 136] bins=300, time limits=[%g %g] bins=256",
    time_elastic+Tmin, time_elastic+Tmax);
  sprintf(lmon_options,"lambda limits=[%g %g] bins=100",lambda-dlambda/2.0,lambda+dlambda/2.0);
  sprintf(tmon_options,"tof limits=[%g %g] bins=100",tmin,tmax);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT PG = Progress_bar() AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
  radius = 0.155,
  focus_xw = 0.03,
  focus_yh = 0.055,
  lambda0 = lambda,
  dlambda = dlambda,
  I1 = 1.4e12,
  T1 = 43.7,
  T2 = 137.2,
  I2 = 2.08e12
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE PG

COMPONENT Guide0 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2) RELATIVE Source

COMPONENT Guide0_copy = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_0 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_1 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_0 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_0

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_2 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_1 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_1

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_3 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_2 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_2

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_4 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_3 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_3

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_5 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_4 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_4

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_6 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_5 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_5

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_7 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_6 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_6

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_8 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_7 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_7

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_9 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_8 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_8

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_10 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_9 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_9

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_11 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_10 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_10

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_12 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_11 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_11

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_13 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_12 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_12

COMPONENT Guide0_copy_14 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_13 ROTATED (0, 2.0/2500, 0) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_13

COMPONENT Guide_PSD = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.03,
  yheight = 0.055,
  options = "y x",
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 2+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide0_copy_14

COMPONENT Guide_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.03,
  yheight = 0.055,
  options = lmon_options,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 1e-4) RELATIVE Guide_PSD

COMPONENT Chopper1 = DiskChopper(
  radius = 0.24,
  yheight = 0.06,
  nu = rpm/60,
  isfirst = 1,
  xwidth = 0.03
) AT (0, 0, 1.2e-2/2) RELATIVE Guide_Lambda

COMPONENT Guide_SGS1 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 1.2e-2) RELATIVE Chopper1

COMPONENT Guide_SGS2 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2.41,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2.41) RELATIVE Guide_SGS1

COMPONENT Guide_SGS3 = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 5.065,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 5.065) RELATIVE Guide_SGS2

COMPONENT Guide_CGS = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2.352,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2.352) RELATIVE Guide_SGS3

COMPONENT Guide2_PSD = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.03,
  yheight = 0.055,
  options = "x y",
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 2.143-2*6e-3+1e-4) RELATIVE Guide_CGS

COMPONENT Guide2_Lambda = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.03,
  yheight = 0.055,
  options = lmon_options,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 1e-4) RELATIVE Guide2_PSD

COMPONENT Guide2_dXY = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.03,
  yheight = 0.055,
  options = "dx dy",
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 1e-4) RELATIVE Guide2_Lambda

COMPONENT Chopper6 = DiskChopper(
  radius = 0.24,
  yheight = 0.06,
  nu = rpm/60,
  delay = 252.78*11.97*lambda*1e-6,
  xwidth = 0.03
) AT (0, 0, 1.2e-2/2) RELATIVE Guide2_dXY

COMPONENT Guide_time = Monitor_nD(
  xwidth = 0.03,
  yheight = 0.055,
  options = tmon_options,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 1.2e-2/2) RELATIVE Chopper6

COMPONENT Guide_DGS = Guide_gravity(
  w1 = 0.03,
  h1 = 0.055,
  l = 2.143,
  m = 1.2
) AT (0, 0, 2.143) RELATIVE Guide_CGS

COMPONENT Sample_pos = Arm() AT (0, 0, 2.143+0.165) RELATIVE Guide_DGS

COMPONENT Sample = Isotropic_Sqw(
  Sqw_coh = coh,
  Sqw_inc = inc,
  xwidth = 0.05,
  yheight = 0.06,
  zdepth = 0.002,
  p_interact = 0.99
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample_pos ROTATED (0, 45, 0) RELATIVE Sample_pos SPLIT 10
EXTEND
%{
  if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;
%}

COMPONENT Ideal_Det = Monitor_nD(
  yheight = 2,
  radius = 2.5,
  options = detector_options,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample_pos

COMPONENT Detector = PSD_Detector(
  nx = 640,
  ny = 256,
  radius = 2.5,
  yheight = 2.0,
  zdepth = 0.01,
  threshold = 100,
  PressureConv = 8,
  PressureStop = 1,
  dc = 0,
  borderx = -1,
  bordery = -1,
  xChDivRelSigma = 0,
  yChDivRelSigma = 0.0037,
  angle = 136-13,
  filename = "NEAT.psd",
  FN_Conv = "Gas_tables/He3inHe.table",
  FN_Stop = "Gas_tables/He3inCF4.table"
) AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Sample_pos ROTATED (0, (136-13)/2+13, 0) RELATIVE Sample_pos

END
